description: Where to play pinball, or a specific machine: "where can I play Godzilla near 97214?", "where can I play pinball in Chicago?", "pinball bars in Portland". Finds pinball venues near a place: a postal code ("60601", "SW1A 1AA" with country gb) or a city ("Chicago", "Portland, OR"). Pass `game` (name or slug) to find venues that have that machine. Returns up to 10 venues, nearest first, with city, distance in miles, machine count, venue kind (bar, arcade…) and `url`, the venue's page on kineticist.com (link it; it has the address and full machine list). `searched` says which place distances are measured from ("central Chicago, IL" is the city centre; "(middle of our venues there)" means a smaller city placed by its venues); `note` says when these are the nearest anywhere rather than nearby. Machine lists come from Pinball Map and can lag.

country.description: Two-letter country code for postal codes outside the US (gb, ca, de…). Default us.

game.description: Only venues that have this game: a name ("Godzilla") or slug (godzilla-2021)

place.description: Postal code or city, e.g. "60601", "Chicago", "Portland, OR"

name: where_to_play
title: Find where to play
